title: There and Back Again: Neutral Outflows in z ∼ 3.5 Quiescent Galaxies
authors: Pengpei Zhu, Kei Ito, Francesco Valentino, et al.
summary: JWST spectroscopy reveals neutral gas outflows in distant quiescent galaxies. Their inferred velocities suggest that much of the gas may return to the host, linking gas recycling to the maintenance of quiescence.
